fields.acceptance: go test ./internal/web/... and ./internal/daemon/... cover the computed address for the default host (127.0.0.1:7787), 0.0.0.0 (0.0.0.0:7787) and ::1 ([::1]:7787), and reject localhost, abc, an empty value and 127.0.0.1:80 with no socket bound; the fake-listener poll sequence includes a poll where only rhiza.web.host changes, to 0.0.0.0, and checks the listener moves to 0.0.0.0:<port>. The daemon-settings testscript lists rhiza.web.host with its default 127.0.0.1, accepts rhiza daemon set rhiza.web.host 0.0.0.0 and ::1, and rejects localhost, abc and an empty value with an error naming the key.
fields.statement: The rhiza.web.host setting names the address the daemon serves the web UI on, 127.0.0.1 by default; rhiza daemon set accepts it only as a literal IPv4 or IPv6 address checked with net.ParseIP (such as 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0, ::1 or ::) and rejects an empty value, hostnames including localhost and anything with a port, with an error naming the key; the listen address is net.JoinHostPort(host, port), and a running daemon moves the listener at its next poll when only the host changes.

fields.acceptance: The daemon-status testscript, after rhiza daemon --once, shows http://127.0.0.1:7787 in text and --json; after rhiza daemon set rhiza.web.host 0.0.0.0 and another --once, it shows http://0.0.0.0:7787; after rhiza daemon set rhiza.web.host ::1 and another --once, it shows http://[::1]:7787.
fields.statement: rhiza daemon status shows the web UI's URL with the effective rhiza.web.host the daemon's last poll recorded, as http://<host>:<port> with an IPv6 host bracketed, so the default still reads http://127.0.0.1:7787.
